title: Environmental and Social Management Framework: Resilient Urban and Territorial Development Project (RUTDP), Volume 1: Main Report
organization: Local Government Engineering Department, Government of Bangladesh
temporal_coverage: Project context in 2024; first project phase planned for 2024-2030.
methodology: Government project ESMF based primarily on the feasibility study and available secondary data.
limitations: Subproject locations and designs were not finalized at preparation; the framework does not report completed outcomes.

title: Country Climate and Development Report: Bangladesh Background Note, Environment, Natural Resources and Blue Economy
geographic_coverage: Chittagong Hill Forests in the east
temporal_coverage: Bangladesh CCDR 2022 background note drawing on studies published in different years.
methodology: CCDR background note synthesizing cited studies on ecosystems, coastal hazards, forests, and livelihoods.
limitations: Evidence combines referenced studies with different dates and methods; this note is not a new field survey.

title: Water and Health: Impact of Climate Change in Bangladesh
organization: World Bank Group, Health, Nutrition, and Population Global Practice
temporal_coverage: Historical studies summarized in a September 2022 discussion paper.
methodology: Summarizes water and health studies by the six ecological zones used in the government Delta Plan 2100.
limitations: The paper describes findings from prior studies and identifies zone-level differences; it is not a new epidemiological survey.
